the learners' ability to describe and express their emotions was very limited and they were not able to use the French lexicon of emotion in an adequate way.
the lexical items used to express emotion are not always appropriate and that the use of the French language in the classroom is not sufficient.
the students were able to express their emotions in a variety of ways and with a variety of emotions, and that they were able to express them in a number of different ways.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the teaching of emotion words to foreign learners of French as a foreign language (FLE) at university level.
how learners of French as a Foreign Language (FFLE) use the lexicon of emotions in their speech production.
the teaching of the emotional vocabulary and its use in a French as Foreign Language (FLE) class.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of emotion words in French as a foreign language is a complex and difficult process.

(a) in general, the use of the lexicon in L2 is more complex and difficult to acquire than in L1 and (b) in order to be able to use the lexicon in the target language, learners need to be aware of the lexical and grammatical differences between the two languages and to have developed their metalinguistic skills.
the teaching of vocabulary in French as a Foreign Language is not only about the learning of words but also about the development of the learner's linguistic competence.

we aim at describing the linguistic abilities that learners of French as a Foreign Language need to develop in order to learn the vocabulary of emotions, as well as the strategies that they employ in order to express and describe their own emotions.

we have examined the lexical resources used in the description and expression of emotions in a foreign language and the difficulties that learners of French as a foreign language face when they have to describe their emotional experiences.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the lexical knowledge of emotions is not a given and that it needs to be developed.

the teaching of the emotional lexicon should take into account the linguistic skills that the students have already developed, and should be based on the activities that are proposed by the textbooks, which should be used as a basis for the elaboration of the teaching activities.
